title: gsm_rlcmac: expand A5 bits in Content_t
description:
It's easier to examine the bitmask of supported A5 algorithms
if each A5 bit is parsed as a separate field:

```
  MS_RA_capability_value_Choice
      .... ...0  1110 10.. = Content Dissector: 58
      u.Content
          .... ..00  1... .... = RF_Power_Capability: 1
          .1.. .... = Exist_A5_bits: 1
          ..1. .... = A5/1: True
          ...0 .... = A5/2: False
          .... 0... = A5/3: False
          .... .0.. = A5/4: False
          .... ..0. = A5/5: False
          .... ...0 = A5/6: False
          0... .... = A5/7: False
```

rather than a single decimal number:

```
  MS_RA_capability_value_Choice
      .... ...0  1110 10.. = Content Dissector: 58
      u.Content
          .... ..00  1... .... = RF_Power_Capability: 1
          .1.. .... = Exist_A5_bits: 1
          ..10 0000  0... .... = A5_bits: 64
```
